Kentucky Retirement Systems decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 1.1% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Kentucky Retirement Systems sold 3,518 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 316,618 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $53.58M, down from 320,136 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kentucky Retirement Systems who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $923.83 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.72% or $1.355 $187.955. About 18.43 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Davis Capital Partners Llc increased its stake in Wells Fargo & Co. New (WFC) by 1.69% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Davis Capital Partners Llc bought 25,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 16.98% with the market. The hedge fund held 1.50 million shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $91.01 million, up from 1.48M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Davis Capital Partners Llc who had been investing in Wells Fargo & Co. New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $265.77B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.20% or $0.11 $54.54. About 9.55 million shares traded. Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE:WFC) has declined 7.75% downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.30% the S&P500.
